item.description:
Performance Improvements, Cleaner Design, Bug Fixes and More...
## What's New - History entries can be removed one at a time, and History and Log rows are more compact, with History metadata in the same capsule as the cards. - Sidebar: choose a collapse animation in View > Sidebar Animation, plus tab counters and labels that type in.
## Changed - Reworked Convert: Add to Queue moved to the bottom of the analyze card, simpler queue rows with Cancel on the one converting, files convert one at a time, and AV1, VP9 and Opus removed from the pickers. - Performance: faster launch, near-zero idle CPU with a card open, and smoother file imports. - New window and layout: opens at 1050×800 centered, pages share one content column (max 850pt), the sidebar auto-collapses below 1000pt, and there's a new gradient background. - Redesigned cards: metadata in one capsule showing full resolution (like 3840×2160), titles in the app font, simpler option rows with tighter spacing, compact collapsed cards, and smaller Select / Collapse All / Clear All buttons. - Redesigned bottom bars: one card with a folder capsule, icon buttons for Browse, Reveal and Auto-open, and no SAVE TO label. - Redesigned the sidebar update block: tool pills like the tabs, one status badge on Check for Updates, and Up to Date returns to Check for Updates after a few seconds. - Smoother sidebar collapse and expand: no slowdown with cards on screen, and the bars, hints and icons move with it instead of jumping.
## Fixes - Fixed several Convert bugs: WAV sources failing to convert, Same as Source getting stuck, H.265 files not playing in QuickTime and Final Cut, and MP3 from surround sources. - Fixed a brief popup flashing next to the paste field at launch. - Fixed chips overlapping in narrow windows and Convert making the window grow taller.
